text: Appeal of Order to Comply (October 25, 2019) 1650 Bathurst Street

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated October 25, 2019, regarding the property located at 1650 Bathurst Street, Folder No. 19 238316 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to July 31, 2020.
